title: Expansion and Mounting of Hydrogel Embedded Brain
author: Rajvi Javeri

steps.title: Expand hydrogel in SSC
steps.instruction: Submerge the hydrogel in 1 L of 0.05 X SSC at room temperature, using a 2 L instrument soaking tray with a strainer insert; replace the SSC solution once per day for at least 2 days.

steps.title: Remove hydrogel from soaking tray
steps.instruction: Carefully lift the gel and strainer from the soaking tray and gently place the expanded hydrogel into a large petri dish.

steps.title: Trim hydrogel to fit cuvette
steps.instruction: Using tissue‑slicer blades and gloved hands, trim the hydrogel on each side so that its dimensions are approximately 3.9–4 cm medial‑lateral and no more than 5 cm rostral‑caudal; smooth all surfaces to minimise air bubbles.

steps.title: Clean chamber and cuvette
steps.instruction: Clean the detachable glass cuvette and its holder with 70 % ethanol and lens‑cleaning wipes to remove dust.

steps.title: Prepare ascorbic acid bath
steps.instruction: Fill a large, deep petri dish with 10 mM ascorbic acid solution (pH 7.0); this solution will be used for both trimming transfer and mounting.

steps.title: Transfer trimmed hydrogel to ascorbic acid
steps.instruction: Place the trimmed hydrogel into the petri dish containing the 10 mM ascorbic acid solution.

steps.title: Insert hydrogel into glass cuvette
steps.instruction: Put the glass cuvette into the same petri dish and, using a gloved hand, carefully guide the hydrogel into the cuvette so it contacts all cuvette surfaces and fits comfortably.

steps.title: Secure cuvette in holder
steps.instruction: Slide the cuvette through the slits in the holder; tighten the side screws with a 1.5 mm ball‑driver screwdriver until resistance is felt; then tighten the top panel with a 7/64 in T‑handle hex key until the panel is snug against the dorsal surface of the hydrogel.

steps.title: Check for air bubbles
steps.instruction: Inspect the mounted sample for any air bubbles; if bubbles are present, detach the cuvette, remove the bubbles, and repeat the mounting steps.

steps.title: Submerge mounted sample in ascorbic acid
steps.instruction: Transfer the assembled cuvette‑hydrogel chamber into a container filled with 10 mM ascorbic acid solution, protect the container from light.

steps.title: Photoprotective incubation before imaging
steps.instruction: Keep the sample in the 10 mM ascorbic acid solution for at least 24 hours (24:00:00) before imaging on the ExA‑SPIM; do not exceed 6 days total exposure to avoid hydrogel dissolution.

steps.title: Verify hydrogel expansion
steps.instruction: Confirm that the hydrogel has expanded to roughly three times its original size; if full expansion is not achieved after 2 days, replace the 0.05 X SSC buffer again.

steps.title: Proceed to imaging
steps.instruction: The sample is now ready to be imaged on the ExA‑SPIM.
